Optional country= for regional pricing. One call instead of checking each distributor. JSON response. [Paid: $0.04 USDC per call via x402 on Base; the calling client pays automatically.]

agents.name: 부품 조회 (재고·시세·대체품)
agents.description: Look up one electronic or industrial part number (or a cable name such as "F-CV 2.5SQ 3C" or "HFIX 2.5SQ") on BIDON, the Korean B2B parts marketplace. Returns Korean sale listings with quantity and price, real recent quotes in KRW with lead time (buyer names hidden), manufacturer specs, same-spec alternatives from other makers, and whether BIDON supplies it directly (MEAN WELL, MORNSUN, CLAF: quote by the same business day). Every result starts with a one-paragraph summary of availability and how to buy, and links the part page where the user can buy or request a quote.
reasons: This tool looks up electronic or industrial part numbers on a Korean B2B marketplace, returning quantity and price.
